run_download_glue_data: run the download_glue_data CLI to download all GLUE benchmark datasets to a specified data directory
download_TASK_dataset: download and extract a GLUE benchmark dataset zip file to a target data directory
format_MRPC_dataset: format MRPC data by splitting train and test files into train, dev, and test tsv files with dev_ids
download_diagnostic_dataset: download the GLUE diagnostic (AX) tsv file into a diagnostic subdirectory
get_tasks_list: parse a comma-separated task name string into a list of valid GLUE task names or all tasks
